article.title: China journal entry of the day
article.excerpt: There is no sun in Chengdu. Or in Ningbo, where I am tonight. The humidity and the coal-burning power plants blot out the sun. There is light, but it is never sunny. It is my understanding that I shall not see the sun except when we are in an airplane. Here is more , from a loyal MR reader.
